property_summary: For any receiver address that reverts when sent value, the reference contract always reverts (so sendTo call fails) while the mutant (which ignores the low-level call return) does not revert; thus for some inputs the reference's call to sendTo will revert but the mutant's will succeed.
change_summary: Replace transfer with a low-level call without checking its return value so failures do not revert while previously they would.
